{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
data_clean = data[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Stratify by customer segment and compute conversion rate and average revenue within each segment
table = pd.crosstab(
    index=[data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']],
    columns='converted',
    values=data_clean['converted'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

revenue_table = pd.crosstab(
    index=[data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']],
    columns='revenue',
    values=data_clean['revenue_clean'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Combine results
results = pd.concat([table, revenue_table], axis=1)
results = results.round(4)

# Compute differences within each segment: email - paid_search
# Get conversion rates by segment and channel
conversion_rates = results['converted'].unstack(level='customer_segment')
# Compute differences
conversion_diff = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Get revenue by segment and channel
revenue_means = results['revenue'].unstack(level='customer_segment')
# Compute differences
revenue_diff = revenue_means['email'] - revenue_means['paid_search']

# Print the differences
print("Conversion rate difference (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(conversion_diff)

print("Average revenue difference (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(revenue_diff)"}
